- *Now is the final chance to purchase an Epic Pass for the 2026/27 winter season*
- *Epic Pass Holders can save up to 35% on winter lodging during the Lodging Cyber Sale*
- *Choose demo rentals that fit the forecast with My Epic Gear; Pass Holders save 20%*


BROOMFIELD, Colo.


, Nov. 16, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- With lifts spinning at Vail Mountain, Breckenridge and Keystone, ski season is officially underway. Whether you'll be chasing powder days, planning a long weekend or spending the whole season on snow, there is still time to save on skiing and riding this winter. It starts with locking in lift access. **The last chance to get an** ****Epic** Pass is December 6** . With options ranging from the season-long Epic Pass to an Epic Day Pass for just 1–7 days, skiers and riders who[buy now](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=3683009010&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fpasses%2Fepic-pass.aspx&a=buy+now) can **save up to 65% compared to lift tickets.** Plus, Epic Pass Holders have access to exclusive savings on lodging, My Epic Gear rentals, and more.


While Vail Mountain, Breckenridge and Keystone in Colorado are already welcoming guests back to the slopes, more resorts like Whistler Blackcomb (BC), Park City Mountain (UT), Heavenly (CA), Beaver Creek (CO) and Crested Butte (CO) are scheduled to open in the coming weeks.


**Save Up to 65% on Skiing and Riding with Epic Pass**
Whether skiing a few days or all season, there's an Epic Pass option to match how you want to spend your winter. New this year, young adults ages 13–30 **save 20% on an Epic Pass or Epic Local Pass** .


- **For powder days and quick getaways:**[Epic Day Pass](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=3301303495&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fpasses%2Fepic-day-pass.aspx%3Fdays%3D4&a=Epic+Day+Pass) (from $50-$106/day) lets skiers and riders choose 1-7 days and decide when and where to use them later.
- **Go all in on winter:**[Epic Pass](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=400109881&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fpasses%2Fepic-pass.aspx&a=Epic+Pass) ($1,245/adult; $995/young adult) offers unrestricted access to 90+ resorts, including Vail Mountain, Breckenridge, Park City Mountain and Whistler Blackcomb.
- **Expand your mountain horizons:**[Epic Local Pass](https://www.epicpass.com/passes/epic-local-pass.aspx) ($959/adult; $759/young adult) offers access to 50+ resorts, including unlimited access to Keystone, Breckenridge and Crested Butte, plus 10 days at Vail Mountain, Whistler Blackcomb and Beaver Creek.


The savings continue throughout the winter. Season-long Epic Pass Holders receive five[Epic Friend Tickets](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=3962071144&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fbenefits%2Ffriend-tickets.aspx&a=Epic+Friend+Tickets) offering 50% off adult lift tickets to share with friends and family. Plus, all Passes come with exclusive savings including 20% off dining, lodging, group ski and ride school lessons, equipment rentals and more through[Epic Mountain Rewards](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=2998284603&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2Fbenefits%2Fepic-mountain-rewards.aspx&a=Epic+Mountain+Rewards) .


**Save Up to 35% on Winter Lodging During the Lodging Cyber Sale**
Lift access isn't the only way to save this winter. Skiers and riders looking to pair their days on snow with a mountain getaway can save during Vail Resorts'[Lodging Cyber Sale](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=3129097150&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.snow.com%2Finfo%2Flodging-deals&a=Lodging+Cyber+Sale) from November 23 to December 7. With Epic Mountain Rewards, Epic Pass Holders unlock the maximum savings with up to 35% off room rates at participating properties, including The Arrabelle and The Lodge at Vail, One Ski Hill Place in Breckenridge and The Osprey in Beaver Creek.


**Gear Up with My Epic Gear Demo Rentals and Save 20% All Season**
Whether carving groomers or skiing fresh powder, access the right gear for every kind of day with[My Epic Gear](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=3188903448&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.myepicgear.com%2F&a=My+Epic+Gear) . Guests who book high-performance Demo rentals at 12 participating resorts this season will receive the curated My Epic Gear experience without a membership fee. Skiers and riders can choose from the latest gear across 13 leading brands, with access to more than 60 ski or snowboard models designed for a variety of conditions. They will also have complimentary access to BOA® ski boots and Step On® bindings.


With My Epic Gear, guests can book the entire gear experience online, before arriving at the resort, with the convenience of free in-resort delivery or in-store pickup. Guests who reserve in advance can save up to 20%, plus Pass Holders enjoy an extra 20% off with Epic Mountain Rewards.


**December 6 is the last chance to purchase an Epic Pass for the 2026/27 season.** Visit[epicpass.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=1864785950&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.epicpass.com%2F&a=epicpass.com) to compare Passes and lock in access for winter.

**About Vail Resorts, Inc.** (NYSE: MTN)
Vail Resorts operates a network of 42 iconic mountain resorts across North America, Europe, and Australia. Our portfolio includes premier destinations such as Vail Mountain, Beaver Creek, Breckenridge, Park City Mountain, Whistler Blackcomb, and Keystone; beloved regional mountains like Stowe, Heavenly, and Northstar; and local resorts close to metro areas that help to introduce the next generation of skiers and riders to the sport. Together, these resorts provide guests with an unmatched range of mountain experiences connected through the Epic Pass. We are passionate about providing an Experience of a Lifetime to our team members and guests. Through our environmental and social responsibility work, we are committed to reaching a zero net operating footprint by 2030, supporting our employees and communities, and broadening engagement in our sport. Beyond our resorts, Vail Resorts operates industry-leading ski and ride school programs, rental operations, distinctive dining and hospitality experiences, retail operations, and the Grand Teton Lodge Company. Learn more about our company at[www.VailResorts.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=2164449632&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.vailresorts.com%252F%26data%3D05%257C02%257CClaire.a.kirkpatrick%2540vailresorts.com%257C50ce3ee2f12c471a255808df394c0ee9%257Ce35ee0a863764761a27954dde1923161%257C0%257C0%257C639292670955229453%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3DbDkLiBaN5alUcxoTZJvnJFKe0g%252F31KCeMyYftLPI5Ac%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=www.VailResorts.com) , or discover our resorts and Pass options at[www.EpicPass.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4823116-1&h=1453866889&u=https%3A%2F%2Fnam02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com%2F%3Furl%3Dhttp%253A%252F%252Fwww.epicpass.com%252F%26data%3D05%257C02%257CClaire.a.kirkpatrick%2540vailresorts.com%257C50ce3ee2f12c471a255808df394c0ee9%257Ce35ee0a863764761a27954dde1923161%257C0%257C0%257C639292670955245496%257CUnknown%257CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%253D%253D%257C0%257C%257C%257C%26sdata%3D%252FN1F0mzm9w7EawdFr73wulo2xstsxBxv8EF7Ug8TIkI%253D%26reserved%3D0&a=www.EpicPass.com) .
